notes.connections:
Keithley 0 (Power Supply) - input rails (VIN range 5.4-40 V, 12 V used here)
    CH1 "Vin1"  -> VIN1  (input for VOUT1 = 5.0 V rail)
    CH2 "Vin2"  -> VIN2  (input for VOUT2 = 3.3 V rail)
    CH3 "Vin34" -> VIN34 (input for VOUT3 = 1.5 V and VOUT4 = 1.2 V rails)
Keysight EL 0 (Electronic Load)
    CH1 "Vout1" <- VOUT1 (5.0 V)
    CH2 "Vout2" <- VOUT2 (3.3 V)
Keysight EL 1 (Electronic Load)
    CH1 "Vout3" <- VOUT3 (1.5 V)
    CH2 "Vout4" <- VOUT4 (1.2 V)
Jumpers: JP1-JP4 (RUN1-RUN4) = ON; JP7/JP9 (MODE/SYNC) = FCM,SSM.
notes.sources:
Keithley 0 - VIN1/VIN2/VIN34 all at 12.0 V (within 5.4-40 V input range).
    CH1 limit 2.0 A (feeds 5.0 V/3 A rail)
    CH2 limit 1.5 A (feeds 3.3 V/3 A rail)
    CH3 limit 1.5 A (feeds 1.5 V/3 A + 1.2 V/3 A rails)
Keysight EL 0 / EL 1 - CC loads, preset to 0 A, input OFF at bring-up.
notes.monitoring:
Keithley 0 - monitor VIN currents on CH1/CH2/CH3.
Keysight EL 0 - monitor VOUT1/VOUT2 load currents and voltages.
Keysight EL 1 - monitor VOUT3/VOUT4 load currents and voltages.
Each output rail is 3 A max continuous per phase (derate per datasheet).
notes.general:
Config: LTM8060 (DC2820A quad output uModule regulator).
Outputs: VOUT1=5.0 V, VOUT2=3.3 V, VOUT3=0.8 V, VOUT4=1.2 V; 3 A max per phase.
Bring-up: preset loads to 0 A, apply VIN (12 V), verify each rail within +/-2%, then raise EL currents (0-3 A) per rail.
Shutdown: EL currents to 0, EL inputs OFF, then Keithley channels OFF.
